gap year side quests

July 24, 2025

my gap year’s almost at its conclusion. part of me wants to say that i completed some grand project, or found my life goal, or embarked on some massive adventure.

though i didn’t. maybe i dabbled in each of these. but i feel like i just went on many side quests, hoping they were good for my soul. was i creating? was i pursuing knowledge or skill? not really. i was just meandering around in a dark forest.

am i regretful? perhaps, but it’s no use to dwell on it. i’m pretty confident i know my path forward, which is not something i could’ve said a year ago. and i’ve procured some self-motivation.

so here’s some stuff i did:

  • spent a semester with pkt
  • lift weights. get injured. wait three months. lift weights. get injured. wait three months. lift weights?
  • go on 39 flights (so far)
  • turned 21
  • struggled a lot with motivation
  • networked :(
  • overslept the putnam (again x3)
  • visited san francisco n times and new york m times (n, m large)
  • mastered my spin move (in basketball)
  • went to edc
  • learned about ML
  • fell in love with ML
  • won 1k from poker in vegas
  • bought an absurd amount of clothes from italy / japan
  • worked as an ML engineer at early-stage startup
  • realized idk what kinda ML i want to do
  • doing some ML research!
  • trying my hand at figma
  • watched one piece
  • got a massive tooth infection
  • went to the ER
  • cooked my first dish
  • wrote 100k+ words in my journal
  • spent time with my girlfriend!
  • read a LOT of short-form content
  • dyed my hair silver
  • saw mt. kilimanjaro
  • played with my dog
  • not lose my fantasy football league
  • way too much brainrot (for a few months)
  • developed strong anti-social media feelings
  • walked up and down new york city
  • bought an amen thompson jersey
  • went to ICML
  • hit 1.25m on nes tetris
  • spent a lot of time with old friends
  • made many new friends
  • cried tears of sorrow and tears of joy
